doc.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997

title: Driving Sinatra's car and their falling out
summary: Palmer's wife drove Sinatra's car for Nancy; Sinatra left him stranded and they stopped speaking for two months.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Well the dancing was connected to ballrooms also, see? So that’s what made bands play the ballrooms, because dancing was there rather than, in some hotels, yes, big hotels would have a band like we played the Hotel Sherman — I can’t think of the name of the room. Anyway, what’d I say, the Hotel Sherman? In Chicago. And the Oriental Theatre there, Chicago Theatre there. And that was our stop in Chicago, and then from there we went to California. So we did a series of one-nighters. Now my wife drove Frank Sinatra’s car, because Nancy couldn’t drive. So Frank’s mother had given him a car to join in Harry’s band. But Nancy couldn’t drive. So Frank wanted the car with him. So my wife drove Nancy, and Jackie was a tot, about three, four years old, and so then he had the car in Chicago, then he had the car in California, and then he had it on the way back you know. But every time we got on location he had a car. And one time I remember he didn’t pick me up, he moved. Somehow the song pluggers were after vocalists, because they needed the words to a song, you see? I wasn’t important, not me alone, any musician, because we just played the music. They needed the vocalist see? The music and the words. So they romanced Frank. So they got him, like we checked in somewhere and I remember waiting for him in the lobby to go to Victor Hugo’s, that’s where we were going to play, and no Frank, he didn’t leave me word or anything, ‘till I double checked now, they says oh he checked out. Jesus was I angry. I was mad. It cost me fifteen dollars, which was a lot of money then, to get a cab to take me to Victor Hugo’s or wherever we were playing. Oh I was rippin’ when I —

Yeah. I didn’t speak to him for two months. I didn’t. I told him off and I didn’t speak to him. I says, “Just stay away from me, I don’t want to.” And we had been roommates you know? But we got together. Because now it came time to leave California, so he started romancing me because he needed Molly, my wife, to drive his car. Nancy couldn’t drive you see? He was a schemer.
What kind of car was it?
I think it was an Oldsmobile. I’m almost sure it was an Oldsmobile. A big car. Anyway.
